title: CoachTurn
description: One turn of a spoken practice conversation: what the coach says back, and — when the learner's own sentence needed it — a better way to have said it. The correction is the point of the exercise; the conversation is what makes a learner produce a sentence at all.

reply.description: What the coach says next, in English. One or two sentences — a learner cannot hold a paragraph said aloud.

replyHindi.description: The same, in Hindi, shown under it. A learner who missed the English can still carry on.

better.description: A better way to say what the learner just said. Absent when their sentence was already fine — most turns should not have one.

text.description: Their sentence, put right, keeping their meaning.

why.description: The rule, in one line of Hindi.

closing.description: True when the conversation has reached a natural end, so the app can offer to finish.
